description: Editable scoring rules for rule-based tender evaluation. Includes value estimation for missing estimated_value. Weights sum to 1.0. Scores 0-100, recommendation from thresholds.

budget_fit.description: Has estimated_value and within acceptable range (0 = no value, 100 = has value and in range)

timeline_fit.description: Days until deadline (more days = higher score, capped)

cost_of_entry.description: Lower booklet_price and initial_guarantee = better (0 = very high cost, 100 = free/low)

scope_clarity.description: Has title and description (0 = missing, 100 = both present and non-empty)

risk_penalty.description: Penalties for missing or risky fields (starts at 100, subtract for risks)

value_estimation.description: Rules for estimating missing estimated_value from available signals. TIGHTENED: ranges reduced from 20x to ~3-4x based on historical IT/Telecom tender analysis.
value_estimation._comment_spread: ±10% range instead of ±20% for tighter initial guarantee estimates
value_estimation._comment_tiers: Calibrated from 94 historical IT/Telecom awards (2026-02-01). Run 'pnpm calibrate-values' to update.
value_estimation._comment_calibration: Run 'pnpm calibrate-values' to regenerate tiers from historical award data
